rationale: Decision: PAUSE. Score: 0.50. Votes: data_analyst=PAUSE, pm_agent=PAUSE, marketing_agent=PAUSE, risk_agent=PAUSE. Search accuracy at 88.9% is still 6.1 points below target after the hotfix. Indexing lag appeared day 7 and is unresolved. Churn at 24/day (3.1x baseline) is still climbing. But 13,500 active users are engaged — pulling the feature disrupts them too. PAUSE gives engineering time to fix both issues properly.
key_drivers: Search accuracy: 88.9% vs 95% target — gap of 6.1 points after hotfix
Churn: 24/day vs baseline 7.3 — lagging indicator, still rising
DAU: 13,500 (+13% above baseline) — engagement is real, rollback would hurt active users

risk_register.risk: Enterprise customer (Globex Corp) affected — board meeting used wrong data
risk_register.mitigation: Direct outreach within 24h, written root-cause + fix timeline

risk_register.risk: Search accuracy at 88.9% — users making decisions on wrong results
risk_register.mitigation: Fix multi-condition query handling, get to 95%+

risk_register.risk: Indexing lag (day 7) — new tasks not appearing in search
risk_register.mitigation: Investigate root cause immediately, revert if necessary

risk_register.risk: Churn at 3x baseline and still climbing
risk_register.mitigation: Proactive outreach to users who filed tickets

action_plan.action: Fix indexing lag — tasks created today not appearing in search
Get search accuracy to 95%+ on complex multi-condition queries
Contact Globex Corp — acknowledge impact, share fix timeline
Keep rollout at 50% — do not expand until metrics stabilise
Identify and process refunds for affected premium users

communication_plan.internal: NovaMind Search is paused at 50% rollout. Engineering is working on accuracy and indexing fixes. Do not expand rollout until further notice.
communication_plan.external: We're aware of search accuracy issues and working on a fix. We'll update you once it's resolved.
communication_plan.enterprise: Call Globex Corp today. Acknowledge what happened. Send a written root-cause and timeline by end of day.
communication_plan.social: Don't post proactively. Respond to direct complaints only. Wait until accuracy is fixed before any public update.

proceed_conditions: Search accuracy >= 95% on production query mix (currently 88.9%)
Indexing lag resolved — new tasks appear in results within 30s
5 consecutive stable days before expanding beyond 50%
Globex Corp sign-off received on resolution
